title: Maintenance, Versioning and Change Management
learningObjectives: Explain the purpose and value of Maintenance, Versioning and Change Management.
Apply maintenance, versioning and change management to a Python project scenario.
Identify decisions and trade-offs relevant to maintenance, versioning and change management.
Review common mistakes and risks in maintenance, versioning and change management.
Produce a verifiable project artifact using maintenance, versioning and change management principles.

understand.concept: Software maintenance includes defect fixes, dependency updates, compatibility changes and improvements after initial delivery. Versioning communicates the nature of changes; changelogs explain user-visible differences. Change management evaluates impact, migration needs, tests and rollback before modifying stable behaviour.
understand.whyItMatters: Maintenance keeps a useful application dependable as its environment and requirements change.
understand.analogy: A vehicle needs scheduled service and a record of repairs after purchase.
understand.analogyLimit: A version number alone does not guarantee compatibility; release notes and tested migration paths matter.
understand.summary: Maintenance, Versioning and Change Management helps learners deliver and maintain reliable Python projects.

explain.narrative: Classify changes as fixes, compatible features or breaking changes. Document user-visible updates, deprecations and migrations. Update dependencies deliberately, test supported Python versions and maintain a rollback path. Review compatibility before changing public function signatures or persisted data formats.
